Negative result: the array's per-vector cells×cycles is 1.6× to 3.9× worse than the best MAC-lane engine. Grid is incomplete (Yosys OOM on 16x8; documented). README, site entry, results and run log included; `python site/build.py` prints ok. Supersedes the stale WIP claim #320.
